annotations.title: Report a data breach (Datenpanne, Art. 33 GDPR)

description: Records a personal data breach in the connected frag.hugo account and starts the 72-hour deadline of Art. 33 GDPR. Step 1 (without `bestaetigung`): returns a preview with the deadline, the competent supervisory authority of the organisation, missing mandatory details for that authority, a draft report in the order of the authority form and the reporting channel, plus a confirmation value valid for 15 minutes. Step 2 (same input plus `bestaetigung`): creates the breach as a draft in frag.hugo; the company admins and the data protection officer are notified. It does not submit anything to the authority and does not decide whether reporting is required. Use only when the user wants to record a breach of their own organisation.

anzahl_unbekannt.description: true if the number of affected persons is not yet known

beschreibung.description: What happened, in plain words (20–4,000 characters). Avoid names of affected persons.

bestaetigung.description: Value from the preview. Omit it to get the preview; send it unchanged to create the breach.

entdeckt_am.description: When the organisation became aware of the breach, ISO 8601 with time zone (e.g. 2026-10-28T09:30:00+01:00). Starts the 72-hour deadline. Not in the future.

risiko.description: Risk to the rights and freedoms of persons as assessed by the organisation; "unklar" if not yet assessed

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

uebung.description: true = practice case (drill): no deadline reminders, no notifications

name: report_data_breach

entwurf_meldung.description: Draft for the report under Art. 33(3) GDPR, in the order of the authority form

title: Report a data breach (Datenpanne, Art. 33 GDPR)
